paragraphs: Local Fishing Handyman LLC is a licensed, bonded and insured handyman based in Troutdale, Oregon, CCB #254463.

We specialize in roofing and roof repairs, softwash moss-off roof treatment, softwashing houses, gutter cleaning and repairs, powerwashing, siding repairs, deck repairs, fence repairs, touch-up painting and more.
Ask about our military and senior citizen discount.
